retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast urban aesthetic featuring a central figure in a vibrant satin suit adorned with oversized gold jewelry and diamond-encrusted 3D typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle, medium close-up of a figure in a lime green satin suit, focusing on hands heavily decorated with large gold rings and accessories, set against a dark purple background with sparkling diamond-textured display type.
coreVisualRelationships: Vibrant green satin fabric against dark purple background
Oversized gold jewelry as primary visual anchors
Diamond-encrusted 3D typography layered over the subject
High-contrast lighting creating sharp highlights on metallic surfaces
coreInvariants: Presence of a 'Parental Advisory' style warning block in the bottom right corner
Heavy use of 3D beveling and metallic textures on display text
Saturated color palette dominated by green, gold, and purple

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium shot focusing on the torso and hands, filling the middle and lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large gold ring/sculpture held in the right hand (viewer's right).
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the sparkling diamond text at the top, moves down to the gold jewelry in the hands, and settles on the belt buckle and advisory logo.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with the subject and large-scale typography.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the green and purple; high value contrast between the dark background and the reflective gold/diamonds.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serifs and wide grotesque sans-serifs
letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses wide, heavy slab serifs with extreme 3D depth
Secondary title uses a diamond-encrusted texture fill
Subtitle uses a stylized, slightly distressed serif with high contrast
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the main title feature horizontal ribbing or 'grill' textures
Top-level text features a sparkling diamond-pave effect
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stacking high-texture display fonts with a clean, boxed sans-serif for the advisory label.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary slab-serif weight for the main title skeleton.
Suitable for the condensed advisory text at the bottom.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A medium shot of a person in a lime green satin suit, hands forward wearing massive gold rings and holding a gold figurine, against a dark purple background with subtle star patterns.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large 3D slab-serif text at the top with a diamond-encrusted texture and silver metallic finish. Place a black and white 'Parental Advisory' box in the bottom right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the main text 3D and textured?
Is the suit fabric visibly satin/shiny?
Is the gold jewelry prominent and reflective?
Is the color palette high-contrast green and purple?

adjustableVariables: Text fill pattern (e.g., gold vs diamond)
mustRedesign: Exact wording of the original titles
postGenerationChecks: Check for 3D depth on the main title
Ensure the 'Parental Advisory' box is present and legible
Verify the satin texture of the clothing
Confirm the gold jewelry has sharp highlights
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Luxury = (Satin Texture + Oversized Gold) * (3D Diamond Typography) / (High Contrast Lighting)
